# Guns Garin Memorial Foundation

> The Guns Garin Memorial Foundation honors the legacy of Major Richard “GUNS” Garin by standing with military families in their hardest moments and inspiring the next generation of aviators.

## Business facts
- Business: Guns Garin Memorial Foundation
- Aid service area: requests are welcome from anywhere, and priority is given to military members, veterans, and families who live in or have a direct connection to South Carolina.
- Apply for aid: https://www.gunsgarin.com/apply-for-aid/
- Flight scholarships: open to applicants ages 15 to 25 who are training toward a Private Pilot License.
